frame.objective: Determine if Cotral Lab should expand its sales to consumers, identify potential consumer segments, propose a value proposition, and outline key investigations before investment.
constraints: No financial data available for Cotral Lab
Test budget of 20,000 EUR and 12-week limit are analyst assumptions
alternatives: Expand to new consumer segments (e.g., hobbyists, musicians, outdoor enthusiasts)
Develop a value proposition for consumers

searches: Hearing protection market trends, consumer behavior, competitor analysis, hearing protection use cases

T1.claim: Consumers are willing to purchase hearing protection if it is perceived as stylish, convenient, and effective, and if it is integrated with popular devices.
T1.who_benefits: Cotral Lab, hearing protection manufacturers, and employers
T1.why_behaviour_changes: Consumers may be more likely to purchase hearing protection if it is seen as a stylish accessory, easy to use, and effective in reducing noise.
T1.how_value_is_captured: Sales revenue, customer satisfaction, and brand reputation
assumptions: Hearing protection is effective in reducing noise
predictions: If Cotral Lab can position its products as stylish and convenient, it may see increased sales to consumers.

revisions.reason: New evidence suggests that while hearing protection with stylish designs may be effective, it may not be suitable for all workplaces.

final.recommendation: Proceed with the proposed test to evaluate the effectiveness of Cotral Lab's value proposition for consumers.
final.value_proposition: Stylish, convenient, and effective hearing protection
final.next_action: Implement the test and monitor results
final.uncertainty: The success of the test depends on consumer adoption of the value proposition
would_change_if: If initial results show low consumer interest, re-evaluate the value proposition
